Aweeesome...! Me too, me too!!
I'm gonna catch up to you, Sis!

Just fine? ...Haha, quite bold, aren't you!
One could even call it carefree.

Now, approaching the final corner, Titan Frying Pan makes her move!
Sweeping up from the outside~!
I will prove its validity through results...!

Biwa Hayahide, substituting for Narita Brian, is pushed into the lead!
The promising Titan Frying Pan is holding a great position from behind!
Well then—it's time. Shall we go?

Expectations for Narita Brian's entry had been exceptionally high.
...There were certainly disappointed murmurs of "It's just her older sister, huh."

Whoa!? Through Passport, known for her front-running style,
is dropping back further and further! What could have happened!?

Fufu... Indeed.
Which means our real work begins right here.
...Just training, though.

Of course, I brought myself to the absolute peak condition possible.
It's just—

Biwa Hayahide allows no pursuit! She pulls away!
What a fearsome, terrifying turn of foot!
Let's hold one final strategy meeting. ...Trainer.

Whoaaa!! Biwa Hayahide breaks away here?!
Leading the pack this entire time, does she still have that much left in the tank?!
Come, let us head back and analyze the data at once, Trainer!
Huh?! Whoa-whoa-whoa, where are you going?!
(...Brian. Are you watching this race from somewhere?)

...Biwa Hayahide decided to enter the Sprout Memorial.
She accepted the role of running as Narita Brian's substitute.

Additionally, "Titan Frying Pan," who is confirmed to transfer to the Central circuit,
is highly likely to race as a late charger.
(...No. For now, that is fine.)
I won't let you overtake me here...!

"Through Passport," well-known in the regional circuit, specializes as a front-runner.
Across all 12 mock races so far, she has led from the front every single time.

Ah, that's right. Trainer, if your brain starts working overtime
and you feel hungry, please don't hesitate to say so.
...To be honest, part of it is just putting on a brave face.
—After all, she's my sister.

Me tooooooooo!!!!
Let's train, train, traaaaaaain!!!!
Yet one day—without fail.
Even so, Biwa Hayahide remained poised and dignified.

—Well then. Are you ready, Trainer?
Let us begin.

It's not like that at all...! Hey, wait!
Don't follow me!!

So loud... Why are you even talking to me?
...I'm leaving.

Yes. Finely chopped vegetables simmered down until meltingly tender...
A nutrient-packed curry even a troublesome, picky eater could enjoy.
(Good. A promising start...!)

My weapon is this theory...!
The "Formula for Victory"!!
Actually, I prepared some curry last night.
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAH...!!)

...Well, the fact that you can state such things without hesitation
is precisely what keeps me grounded, I suppose.
The back of the older sister you once chased after...!
Besides—
...I want to be the kind of sister who can keep a promise to her sibling.
I will show you... I will make you remember.

To bring the "Formula for Victory" even one step closer to perfection...
It's all about non-stop adjustments, revisions, and refinements!!

...HAAAAAH!!!!! I'm totally fired up!
Just look at Hayahide!! Right, Taishiiiiin?!

First place.
...Well, only the expected outcome.

WOOOOOOOOOOO!! BI-WA-HA-YA-HI-DE!!
That was an in...credible race, Taishiiiiin!!

Now, regarding today's opposition, I have gathered the data.
Two Umamusume warrant special attention—

(Or have you already moved so far ahead of me
that I am no longer even in your sights?)

Biwa Hayahide! It's Biwa Hayahide!
The name of the Umamusume to lead the next generation is Biwa Hayahide!!!
I'll make her chase after me!!
My back—

Under clear blue skies, the Sprout Memorial gets underway!
What kind of race will these ten next-generation Umamusume deliver today?!

And so, while enjoying her special curry,
Hayahide and I spent day after day reviewing and refining her theories. And then—

—And so began the days of working alongside Biwa Hayahide,
striving to bring the "Formula for Victory" to perfection!

*pant, pant*... All right!
Let's pick up the pace even more, Brian!
Well... we have successfully produced results.

The day of the Sprout Memorial.
Under a crystal-clear sky, a massive crowd had gathered at the racetrack.

Good morning, Trainer.
...The weather and wind conditions are flawless.

Yet, by my side... I have those who believe in proving my theories,
who believe in the completion of my "Formula for Victory."
Her cautious nature and sheer mental fortitude... closely resemble Brian's.
